description: Check a caller-supplied pack of prompt templates: placeholders used vs variables declared, version format, and deterministic test renders with supplied values. Returns the report only; nothing is published or written.

renders.description: Test renders to run against the pack (optional)

template.description: Name of the template to render

values.description: Values for the render: a map from variable name to replacement string

templates.description: Prompt templates to check, in pack order

name.description: Template name, unique within the pack

version.description: Template version, exactly three dot-separated non-negative integers (e.g. "1.2.0")

name: check_prompt_pack
